title: finance-budget-1on1-prep-samir-2026-q1
body:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Priya (Finance lead) - budget/run-rate review, procurement approvals
Date: 2026-03-04 (meeting scheduled)
Purpose: quick sync to align on Q2 run-rate assumptions, agree procurement approvals to push through this week, and confirm cost saving targets

Goals for the 1:1:
- Validate updated run-rate and MTD spend numbers (I'll bring latest calc).
- Get Priya sign-off on two pending POs (Nimbus GPU pool, Vendor: CloudInfra).
- Lock in budget re-alloc for SRE hiring freeze mitigation ($150k).
- Agree next steps for vendor contract renewal cadence (defer/renew/renegotiate).

Run-rate / spend snapshot (talking points, not final):
- Monthly run-rate (current): $1,125,000 (avg last 3 months).
- YTD spend variance vs forecast: +5.4% ($72k over forecast) driven by infra (spot/scale inefficiencies) and one-off data transfer costs.
- MTD (Feb): $1,160,000 - includes two large invoices: CloudInfra Feb invoice (PO-2026-038) and ad-hoc consultant engagement (FIN-412).
- Q2 projection (base): $1,090,000/mo if we hit savings target; optimistic scenario $1,025,000/mo with proposed batching/commit changes.
- Quick math to show in meeting: expected Q2 savings if we approve Nimbus reserved pool: ~$45k/mo (net of commitment).

Key line items to highlight:
- Infra: 43% of spend (GPU + storage + egress). Main levers: reserved vs on-demand balance, better batching, commit discounts.
- SRE headcount contingency: $150k reallocation request (covers 2 contractors for Q2) to avoid incident risk.
- Tools/Observability: renewals due May - $120k annual; consider 6-month deferral conversation.

Procurement approvals pending (need Priya ok or sign-off):
1) PO-2026-045: Nimbus Cloud - reserved GPU pool (6-month commit). Request: $270k total. Rationale: reduces per-token cost 18% for heavy inference runs. Status: awaiting finance approval + legal review notes.
2) PO-2026-048: CloudInfra - networking egress credits top-up $45k. Status: vendor clarifications pending; need to confirm spike pattern.
3) CONSULT-221: Data engineering consultant (ad-hoc) - additional 120 hours ($36k). Status: manager approval done, require procurement to route.

Risks / open questions to surface:
- If we push Nimbus commit and traffic doesn't materialize, we're stuck with committed spend. Can we negotiate quarterly true-up? (Action: ask Legal if we can add a usage true-up clause)
- Are there any hidden license/egress clauses in CloudInfra that will spike in Q2? (Action: follow up with infra lead)
- Timing: if we miss current procurement window, renewal rates may increase in April.

Agenda (10-15 min 1:1):
- 0:00-02:00 quick status + confirm goals of this sync
- 02:00-06:00 run-rate & MTD numbers (I present updated spreadsheet)
- 06:00-10:00 procurement approvals - go over PO-045 and PO-048 (need verbal ok to push through)
- 10:00-13:00 risk items & negotiable terms (legal/ops flags)
- 13:00-15:00 confirm action items and owners

Notes I want to confirm live:
- Priya: ok to green-light PO-2026-045 if Legal can add 30-day true-up clause?
- Priya: agree to re-allocate $150k from hiring contingency to SRE contractors for Q2?
- Priya: ok to defer Observability renewal conversation to May if we hit infra savings target in Apr?

Draft language for approval emails (copy/paste-ready):
- To Procurement: "Requesting approval to execute PO-2026-045 (Nimbus reserved GPU pool). Finance has reviewed projected ROI; Legal to confirm standard true-up clause acceptance. Target execution by 2026-03-10."
- To Vendor (Nimbus): "We intend to commit to a 6-month reserved pool; please confirm if quarterly true-up/term adjustment is possible and send updated SOW by EOD 2026-03-06."

Action items (post-meeting):
- Samir: finalize spreadsheet with line-item drilldown and share with Priya (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya: provide verbal ok on PO-2026-045 pending Legal clause (meeting).
- Legal (cc: Maya): review PO-2026-045 SOW and propose true-up contract language (due 2026-03-06).
- Infra lead (Ethan): confirm egress patterns and risk of CloudInfra top-up (due 2026-03-05).
- Procurement: prep PO paperwork for PO-2026-045 and PO-2026-048 (ready to route if Priya ok)

Quick links / refs to paste in meeting chat:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/456789/Budget+Q2+Plan
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-412
- PR (finance): https://github.com/redwood/finance/pull/88 (cost breakdown spreadsheet)

Notes to self (personal):
- Bring two slide screenshots: monthly run-rate trend, infra spend waterfall.
- Keep ask concise: approval for PO-045 + sign-off on $150k reallocation.
- If Priya pushes back, propose 3-month Nimbus pilot at 60% commit (fallback).

Tone: concise - this is a tactical 1:1 to get decisions, not to re-hash full Q2 plan.

End of prep notes.
